$schema_comment: billers.json — biller → Notion row map for the email-bills-classify-and-remind cron. Edit this file when a new biller needs to be recognized. Each entry: sender/subject patterns to match, the exact Notion Name to find, and the extraction recipe to use for the attachment (emcali-pdf, claro-html, tigo-html, gas-pdf, ...). The cron loads this file at the top of every tick. New billers are added by the unknown-biller digest report path: when an email comes in that looks like a bill but matches no entry, the cron reports it to #roboin-digest so a human can add the row + the billers.json entry.

$how_to_add.1: Look at the digest report (sender + subject + amount if known).
$how_to_add.2: In Notion Bills DB, confirm there is (or create) a row whose Name matches the biller. Use the existing emoji convention (e.g. "Claro 🛜").
$how_to_add.3: Add an entry below: name_match = list of sender-domain / subject substrings that uniquely identify this biller; notion_name = exact Name in the DB; extract = which recipe in the cron prompt to follow for parsing the attachment.
$how_to_add.4: Commit the change to the hermes config repo. The next cron tick picks it up.

billers.notes: Cali utility bill. Body is a tracking-link stub; data is in Factura_EmCali_*.zip (UBL XML has cbc:AccountingCostCode = No. Pago Electrónico). PDF has the same 9-digit code on page 1 upper-right. Account holder: Diana Maria Vargas Castellanos, contract 47041524. Bill period (Mes Cuenta) is one month before the due date — e.g. June bill is due in early July.

Nu Colombia payment receipts. Subject is always 'Tu comprobante de pago de servicio.' Body has the biller (Empresa) and amount (Monto). There is NO PDF/XML attachment — the body IS the receipt. The cron dispatches to bill_receipt.py which renders a phone-friendly PNG screenshot of the receipt, uploads it to Notion, and appends it as a file block on the matching row. Notion name is NOT hardcoded here — the receipt's 'Empresa' field is mapped to a Notion Name at render time via the EMPRESA_TO_NOTION dict in bill_receipt.py. Known mappings: 'Tigo Móvil' -> 'Tigo 📱', 'Claro Hogar' -> 'Claro 🛜', 'Acueducto Y Energia - Emcali' -> 'Utilities ⚡️'. The cron marks the row Paid=Done if not already and PATCHes Price to the real amount. Idempotency: each comprobante has a unique 'Código de operación' (UUID); if that code is already present in any block on the page, the cron skips the attach (no duplicate screenshots on re-passes). Distinguish from 'Pagaste en <merchant> con Cuenta Nu' (card purchases, NOT bills) — different subject, not matched by name_match.

GASES DE OCCIDENTE S. A. E.S.P. (NIT 800167643) — natural-gas biller for the Cali house. Sender domain is `gdo.com.co`; the literal sender address is `facturacionelectronica@gdo.com.co`. Subject follows a tracking-link stub shape: `<NIT>;<RAZON_SOCIAL>;<DOCUMENT_NUMBER>;<CODE>;<RAZON_SOCIAL>;` (e.g. `800167643;GASES DE OCCIDENTE S. A. EMPRESA DE SERVICIOS PUBLICOS;GDO32601764;01;GASES DE OCCIDENTE S. A. EMPRESA DE SERVICIOS PUBLICOS;`). Body is an HTML stub with due date (e.g. `18/JUL/2026`), 7-digit ref (e.g. `2361169`), and total (e.g. `57,785`). Real billable data is in the ZIP attachment (`<NIT><DATE>...<DOCUMENT_NUMBER>.zip`) which contains `<REF>_<MMYYYY>_<DOC>.pdf` and `ad<NIT><DOC>.xml`. The PDF has the human-readable bill (3+ pages, layout from DIAN Colombian electronic invoice standard); the XML has all fields in clean tags inside the embedded `<CustomData>` block of the inner Invoice. EXTRACT FROM XML (preferred over PDF — structured): `<CUPON_REFERENCIA>` = 9-digit electronic payment code (equivalent to EMCALI's `No. Pago Electrónico`); `<TOTAL_PAY>` = total COP; `<DATE_LIMITED_PER>` = due date in `DD/MMM/YYYY` format (e.g. `18/JUL/2026`). FALLBACK TO PDF if XML is malformed: `pdftotext -layout`, then grep for `57,785` and the 9-digit ref near the `Código de referencia para pago electrónico` label. Account holder is `DIANA MARIA VARGAS CASTELLANOS`, contract `<NUMERO_CONTRATO>` 2361169. If a row for the current month doesn't exist, report `missing row` (do not auto-create — user controls that). Pattern modeled on the EMCALI flow (see references/emcali-bill-extraction.md) but the field labels are GDO-specific. Confirmed working with the 2026-07-08 bill (msg 1314, ref `384772848`, amount `57,785`, due `2026-07-18`).

COMCEL S.A. (Claro Colombia, NIT 800153993) — internet/TV/home service for the Cali house. Account number 53517534. TWO sender types cover the same Notion row: (1) main billing from `facturasclarocol@claro.com.co` with subject shape `<NIT>;<RAZON_SOCIAL>;<REF>;<CODE>;<SERVICE_LABEL>;` (e.g. `800153993;COMCEL S.A.;R1157335414;01;CLARO;HOGAR`) and body containing `NO. DE CUENTA:`, `MES:`, `VALOR A PAGAR:`, `FECHA DE PAGO:`; (2) dunning/collections from `notificacionescartera@claro.com.co` with subject `Tu factura de servicios Claro hogar está en mora...` and body containing `No. de Cuenta`, `Mes`, `Valor a pagar`. ZIP attachment is `<NIT><DATE>...<REF>.zip` with `<REF>.pdf` (PASSWORD-PROTECTED — do not attempt pdftotext without the customer's NIT/account number) and `fv<NIT>...<REF>.xml`. The XML is the safe extraction source. EXTRACT FROM XML: `<cbc:ID>` (top-level) = the R-prefixed payment ref (e.g. `R1157335414`); the body's `VALOR A PAGAR` field is the canonical total (the XML's `<cbc:PayableAmount>` is the current-cycle only and may differ from the body's total by a previous-balance carry-over — always prefer the body's `VALOR A PAGAR`). Due date: main bills say `FECHA DE PAGO INMEDIATA` (no real due date — use the bill's `Mes` field for month-matching); dunning notices have an explicit `Fecha límite de pago`. GOTCHA — the body's `VALOR A PAGAR` (e.g. 186,768) is OFTEN higher than the XML's `<cbc:PayableAmount>` (e.g. 174,068) when there's a carried-over balance. If a dunning notice arrives for a different amount than the main bill, treat it as a SEPARATE bill with its own due date — do NOT silently add it to the main bill's row Price. PATCH the row's Price to the dunning's amount if and only if no main-bill email has been processed for the same month yet, and report a one-line `⚠️ multiple Claro bills for <month>: main $<main> + dunning $<dunning> — verify with carrier` so the user can reconcile. The receipt path (Nu comprobantes → `Claro 🛜`) is already wired in `receipt_billers.json` (entry `claro-hogar`); no change needed there.
